input.summary:
Drinks Chiller at Ikeja Depot Shop: audit confidence 0.84 (acceptable), compliance 73%, planogram share 100%, no unknown products. 3 of 11 planogram SKUs stocked out: Sprite 50cl PET, Five Alive Citrus 1L, Maltina 33cl Can. The other 8 slots are at expected facings.

Inventory check showed all three are at or below their reorder point, so I proposed one order each: Sprite 1 case (12u, ~N3,600), Maltina 1 case (12u, ~N5,400), Five Alive Citrus 2 cases (24u, ~N33,600). Total ~N42,600.

Important for the manager: Sprite (5 units) and Maltina (3 units) are empty on the shelf but DO have stock in the back room - those two need an immediate shelf refill today, not just a delivery. Five Alive Citrus is genuinely at zero on hand and can only be fixed by the incoming order.

Manager notified via WhatsApp with the refill instruction and order details. No telemetry was available for the chiller and no visible damage was reported, so no technician was dispatched; I asked the manager to visually check the chiller temperature on the next pass.
